title: Jurisdictional proof assembly and evidence playbook for SOC 2 / ISO 27001
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Background: Customers in regulated regions require a reproducible, auditable package of artifacts that proves control execution and data handling across jurisdictions (SOC 2 / ISO 27001). Current evidence exports are ad-hoc: logs and retention metadata are scattered across S3 buckets, CloudTrail, and internal dashboards. This ticket defines a coordinated playbook and implementation surface for assembling jurisdiction-aware evidence bundles and automating retention assertions for audit reporting.

Goal: Provide a first-class "Jurisdictional Proof Assembly" feature that: 1) collects mapped artifacts for a selected control(s) and timeframe; 2) enforces region-specific retention metadata and residency labels; 3) produces signed evidence bundles (JSONL manifest + PDF summary + cryptographic attestations) consumable by external auditors; 4) integrates with Console exports and Customer S3 buckets; 5) supports SOC 2 and ISO 27001 control mappings out of the box.

Non-goals: Full legal attestation for third-party providers, replacing external audit workflows, or on-prem collector agents for air-gapped systems in this phase.

Acceptance criteria: 
- UI flow in Console to select jurisdiction(s), controls (mapped to CCM/ISO clauses), and time window.
- Evidence collector connectors implemented for: audit logs (CloudTrail), runtime trace snippets (tokenized request IDs), KMS/HSM audit entries, and retention policy snapshots.
- Each bundle includes: artifacts (list of file refs), manifest.jsonl with per-artifact provenance, retention assertion per region, and a signed summary PDF.
- Export formats: zip with structured JSONL + PDF + SHA256 checksums; Lambda/CLI endpoint for automated retrieval.
- RBAC: only users with "Compliance Export" role can generate/join bundles; audit trail of export events retained for at least 1 year.
- Load: generating a 30-day bundle for a medium customer (<1TB of artifacts) completes <15 minutes under dedicated capacity.

Implementation notes: 
- Control mapping: use existing control catalog (Console->Settings->Controls) and extend mapping to include evidence types and collector adapter IDs.
- Collectors: define standard event schemas. Work with ENG to build streaming proof collectors that tag events with region/residency and retention policy version. Collectors emit to a "proof-collection" topic that assembly service consumes.
- Assembly service: orchestrates retrieval, normalizes timestamps to UTC and jurisdiction-local timestamps, computes checksums, and signs the bundle with a platform key (customer-level HSM integration optional).
- Retention settings: reflect customer-configured retention per region; any artifacts whose retention policy would be violated by export must be flagged and require explicit reviewer approval.
- Security: signed manifests, detection of missing provenance, rate-limits to prevent exfiltration, and an export approval step for high-sensitivity customers.

Rollout plan: 
1) Prototype collector + assembly for CloudTrail + Console export UI (MVP) — pilot with 3 customers.
2) Extend collectors for KMS/HSM logs and token-level traces.
3) Add signed artifacts and HSM integration for cryptographic attestations.
4) Finalize performance SLOs and GA in console-2025.04.

Success metrics: 
- Time-to-generate 90th percentile bundle < 20 minutes.
- Pilot customers able to retrieve bundles and pass initial internal audit validation for 80% of mapped controls.
- Reduction in manual auditor requests for provenance by at least 60% for pilot accounts.

Risks & mitigations: 
- Large artifact volumes: implement sampled manifests and incremental exports; recommend burst capacity reservation for heavy exports.
- Sensitive data leakage: enforce RBAC, throttling, and an approval process, and optionally scrub PII from artifacts using redactors.
- Cross-region consistency: store evidence manifests with both UTC and region-adjusted timestamps and include timezone metadata.
